verdict.rationale: The official huggingface/huggingface_hub repo documents the `hf` CLI for listing inference-served models, uploading files and running jobs on HF infrastructure. It also ships an `hf` CLI Skill for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor, which covers the AI-native angle directly. Missing for 10: in-depth dedicated CLI reference documentation in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: If you use Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another coding agent, install the `hf` CLI Skill — a command reference generated from your installed CLI:
# Run a job on Hugging Face infrastructure
